hooks.name: Run autopsy when a workbook is added to graveyard
hooks.description: Runs the autopsy on any .xlsx or .xlsm workbook newly added to /graveyard. Macros are never executed.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys,re,subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); m=re.search(r'[^\"\s]*graveyard/[^/\"\s]+\.xls[xm]', d); sys.exit(0) if not m else sys.exit(subprocess.call(['python3','-m','ghost.cli','autopsy',m.group(0)]))"
